item.title: BarKeep 0.0.10
item.description:
What's New

BarKeep 0.0.10

Fixes

  • Download progress shows the real downloaded size now (e.g. "45 MB", climbing) instead of just an indeterminate bar — with a true percentage bar when the total is known (Safari and App Store downloads). The download icon is a clean blue arrow.
  • "What's New" now appears only once per version, and shows the correct version number and the current release's notes.

Earlier in 0.0.x

  • Custom Macros — type a trigger like EST# and BarKeep replaces it with text, dynamic tokens ({date}, {uuid}, {clipboard}), a shell script's output, a list pick, or a keystroke sequence; triggered by an abbreviation or a global hotkey.
  • Reserve space behind the notch so menu-bar icons don't hide under the cutout (MacBooks with a notch).
  • Optional precise-location weather (skippable; IP-based otherwise).
  • Notched-Mac layout polish, tidier permissions screen, and various fixes.

System

  • Runs as a quiet menu-bar agent; universal (Apple Silicon + Intel); auto-updating via Sparkle.
